facts.description: An opinionated personal dashboard for your terminal — world clocks, calendar and agenda, weather, tasks, notes, markets and live system metrics in a tab you leave open all day. Rust + ratatui.

research.name: mirador
research.note: Terminal dashboard of clock, calendar, tasks, notes and system panels that dims all but the focused one and rearranges by keyboard.

effects: single lit focused panel with its key hints set into the bottom border while every other panel is dimmed
keyboard arrange mode that moves live panels between rows and reflows the grid
block-numeral clock panel that collapses to a one-line time when its row shrinks
